name: ProHoster
notes:
ProHoster is a reliable international provider of cloud infrastructure, high-performance web hosting, and domain management services. Engineered to support developers, tech startups, e-commerce stores, and digital agencies, ProHoster offers scalable hosting solutions tailored for modern web apps, AI tools, and high-traffic online platforms.

Core Offerings:

NVMe VPS/VDS: Ultra-fast virtual private servers with full root access, guaranteed resources, and instant deployment.

Dedicated Servers: Custom bare-metal hardware designed for heavy computational workloads and enterprise projects.

Shared Web Hosting: Feature-rich plans equipped with intuitive control panels, 1-click CMS installers, and automated backups.

Domain Services & Proxies: Seamless TLD registration, high-anonymity proxy solutions, and free SSL protection.

Backed by a 99.9% uptime SLA, advanced DDoS mitigation, and 24/7 expert technical support, ProHoster delivers the speed and stability your business needs to scale globally.
